questions.stem_text:
Which statement best describes one of Dworkin's central arguments in Justice for
Hedgehogs?

options.A: The law is the only guide for ethical behaviour.
options.B: The law dictates what moral values should affect our ethical behaviour.
options.C: Morality plays no role in the concept of law.
options.D: Moral arguments operate only in hard cases.
options.E: Morality only applies to specific, complex cases.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - The law is the only guide for ethical behaviour.

questions.stem_text:
Which case was the first to define the meaning of the doctrine of 'margin of appreciation'
as applied by the European Court of Human Rights?
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Dudgeon v UK (1981)

questions.stem_text: Do treaties bind third States, ie non-State parties?

options.A: Treaties do no create obligations or rights for third States without their consent
options.B: Treaties create both obligations and rights for third States
options.C: Treaties do not create any rights for third States, even when the latter consent.
options.D: Treaties may create only obligations for third States
options.E: Treaties create obligations for third States without their consent

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Treaties do no create obligations or rights for third States without their consent

questions.stem_text:
What is it called when a remainder in the grantor's heirs is invalid and becomes a
reversion in the grantor?
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Doctrine of Worthier Title

questions.stem_text:
Maine's famous aphorism that 'the movement of progressive societies has hitherto been a
movement from Status to Contract' is often misunderstood. In what way?

options.A: His concept of status is misrepresented.
options.B: It is misinterpreted as a prediction.
options.C: His idea is considered inapplicable to Western legal systems.
options.D: It is incorrectly related to economic progression.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - It is misinterpreted as a prediction.
